component.name: Tab Companion
component.summary: Configure the S Pen, keyboard and fingerprints
Configura el S Pen, el teclado y las huellas
Configurer le S Pen et le clavier de couverture
Configura la S Pen e la cover con tastiera
Configurar a S Pen e a capa com teclado

description.p: Configure S Pen actions and the special keys of Samsung's cover keyboard from a lightweight native GNOME application.
Saves diagnostic reports reliably and adds explicit, time-limited cover keystroke capture.
Adds keyboard cover diagnostics, completes translations and fixes GTK notification haptics.
Fixes offline package installation, Spanish text encoding and visibility of failed updates.
Requires a charger for system updates only below 20 percent battery.
Simplifies the update page and adds hold or Shift-click access to current-build reinstallation.
Shows complete release notes with larger, non-selectable text and page scrolling instead of a clipped nested viewport.
Stops offering legacy installation ZIPs as updates and distinguishes newer, older and unversioned builds.
Redesigns system updates with measured download progress, transfer speed, time estimates, preparation stages and release notes.
Adds system updates from GitHub or a local build ZIP, preserving user data and settings, with offline installation and current-build repair.
Clarifies the Ubuntu Settings shortcut on the fingerprint page.

Simplifies fingerprint settings, keeps the saved list visible during tests and highlights the recognized finger. Tests use one continuous identification operation. Enrollment and testing cancel silently after one minute without a new touch.

Replaces the diagnostic Info tab with shared-system fingerprint settings: ten finger choices, confirmed deletion, named scanning, live enrollment feedback and a renewable 30-second inactivity limit. Releases the reader between operations and links to Ubuntu Settings.
Add bounded verification of the saved fingerprint with explicit match, non-match and error feedback, without re-enrollment.
Retains the final secure fingerprint result when a diagnostic run exits.
Clarifies the press-hold-release flow used by buffered optical capture.
Uses secure aggregate counters for progress and retains per-contact EL721 diagnostics.
Fixes the fingerprint test duration control on Ubuntu 24.04.
Adds a bounded live fingerprint test with countdown, real secure progress, cancellation and structured local logs.
Disables S Pen remote controls while Bluetooth is off and restores the saved preference immediately when it returns.
Clarifies that the vibration test reproduces the selected keyboard strength.
Makes the vibration test reproduce the selected on-screen keyboard strength.
Places S Pen remote controls after behaviour settings and removes the oversized vibration illustration.
Recovers stale docked S Pen bonds promptly after reboot and hardens pairing-service startup.
Maps the S Pen side button to a held left click in pointer mode for clicking and dragging.
Corrects both pointer axes, balances horizontal travel, strengthens keyboard haptics and credits PenMouse S.
Detects and automatically repairs unresponsive S Pen GATT links without showing cached battery values.
Fixes continuous S Pen pointer motion, strengthens keyboard haptics and adds notification vibration.
Fixes automatic S Pen re-pairing when BlueZ recreates the device during the dock pairing window.
Adds S Pen remote control modes, air pointer, keyboard haptics and live dock orientation refresh.
Apply the useful keyboard behaviour through Keep the default action instead of storing it as a custom mapping.
Add graphical key simulation, useful special-key defaults, S Pen hover rejection and docked digitizer control, flashlight actions, and automatic stale-bond recovery.
Redesign keyboard discovery and action selection, add application and command pickers, improve S Pen status and add translations.
Pair the docked S Pen automatically, report its BLE battery level and map all six physical air gestures.
Fix touch-scrolled action selection and map the measured EF-DX920 special keys.
Handle single, double and long S Pen button presses without BLE.
Add cover-key learning and the uinput action engine.
Show the measured S Pen dock, orientation and charging state through the hardware service.
